name: Cape Leeuwin
_note: Augusta to Cape Leeuwin: Blackwood Avenue through the town, then Leeuwin Road south over the low hills past the turn to the water wheel, ending at the lighthouse car park where the Indian and Southern Oceans meet. Point to point, about 7.5 km, on the 30 m fallback heights. The last pin takes it into the lighthouse precinct car park (OSRM routes there cleanly).

build._areaNote: Landmark patches: small areas joining the road to landmarks that stand beyond the 70 m corridor, so they get detailed terrain (and their own streets) to stand on instead of the horizon mesh. streetsValid stays off so side streets along the road still count as off track, as without an area. One strip from the road's end south past the waterwheel and the keepers' cottages to the lighthouse (OSRM stops the route about 570 m short of it, at the precinct).
